old: Any input path the prompt does promise under /app/data/ actually exists in environment/
new: Any input path the prompt does promise under an input COPY destination (/app/data/, /app/repo/, ...) actually exists in environment/
impact: Script-owned by instruction_qc.py C4/C5 (script unchanged; C4 already resolves any COPY). Prompts may name /app/<dir>/ paths for every input directory.

old: All input lives in environment/data/ and at least one file exists there; environment/ holds only the Dockerfile and data/. Script-owned.
new: All input lives in one or more input directories under environment/ (any names), each holding at least one file and each copied into the image by environment/Dockerfile; environment/ holds only the Dockerfile and those directories. Script-owned (structure_qc S3, S4).
impact: Builders may split input into named dirs (repo/, ci/, fixtures/). Each dir needs its own COPY line. Severity FAIL, threshold >=1 file per dir.

old: Deleting environment/data/ must make the task unsolvable.
new: Deleting the input directories must make the task unsolvable, and so must deleting any single one of them; a directory the agent need not open is residue (fail).
impact: Stricter for multi-dir bundles: every input directory must be load-bearing. Manual, FAIL.

old: Nothing in environment/data/ may contain ... the expected final output.
new: Nothing in any environment/ input directory may contain ... the expected final output.
impact: Answer-leak scan now covers every input directory. Manual, FAIL.

old: Must copy data/ into the image at the path the instruction uses (/app/data).
new: Must copy every input directory into the image at the path the instruction uses (conventionally /app/<dir>, e.g. /app/data, /app/repo).
impact: Manual, FAIL when instruction and image disagree. Instruction paths must match each COPY destination.

old: The oracle MAY read environment/ (... where /app/data exists).
new: The oracle MAY read environment/ (... where the input directories exist).
impact: Allowance only; no action.

old: Nothing under tests/ may unconditionally read /app/data at grade time.
new: Nothing under tests/ may unconditionally read an agent input path (/app/data or any other input COPY destination) at grade time.
impact: Tests must embed every input dir they need (generator {{SHIPPED:<dir>}}); no grade-time read of /app/repo, /app/ci etc. FAIL, script D1.

old: Nothing under tests/ reads /app/data unconditionally.
new: Nothing under tests/ reads an agent input path (/app/data or any COPY destination of an input directory) unconditionally.
impact: Script-owned (tests_qc D1). Same action as TS-1.

old: tests_qc D1 flags any unconditional '/app/data' string under tests/
new: D1 flags any unconditional string naming /app/data or any destination environment/Dockerfile COPYs an input directory to (input_mounts); COPY . (whole context) is NOT expanded at HEAD (8c37863a fix reverted by the merge)
impact: Wider net: strings like '/app/repo/...' in test_output.py now FAIL unless guarded. FAIL.

old: tests reading anything agent-writable (/app/data reads crash - Gate 03; ...)
new: tests reading anything agent-writable (input-path reads such as /app/data crash - Gate 03; ...)
impact: Wording only.

old: annotations keys: mode, type (effect: VALUE/EFFECT/ABSENCE/INVARIANT/ORDERING/DIVERGENCE), evidence, residue, kind (outcome/constraint/conduct), category, evaluation_target, importance, + contract_sentence/contract_file (constraint) or serves (conduct); kind=constraint iff category=instruction following
new: annotations keys exactly: mode, type (the category: task completion, instruction following, tool use, agent behavior, factuality and hallucination, safety and boundaries), evaluation_target, importance. category, kind, serves, residue, evidence, contract_sentence, contract_file are retired and FAIL.
impact: Every judge.toml criterion must carry exactly the 4 keys in order; put the old category value in type. Constraint criteria are marked only by type = "instruction following".

old: [criterion.annotations] carrying mode, type, evidence, residue, kind, category, evaluation_target, importance in that order, then contract_sentence/contract_file or serves (script J6)
new: [criterion.annotations] carrying exactly mode, type, evaluation_target, importance in that order, nothing else; retired keys fail (script J6)
impact: Script-owned, FAIL. Old-shape judge.toml now fails J6 on every criterion.

old: ANNOTATION_BASE 8 keys + kind-dependent extras
new: ANNOTATION_KEYS = [mode, type, evaluation_target, importance]; hint lists retired keys
impact: Script FAIL; see JD-S8.

old: type from the effect set, residue one plain sentence, safety category with 'and', kind and category agreeing (script J7)
new: type from the category set with 'safety and boundaries' spelled with 'and'; evaluation_target and importance from their sets (script J7)
impact: Script-owned, FAIL. residue/kind/category checks gone.

old: type in EFFECTS; residue sentence check; kind in KINDS; category in CATEGORIES; kind/category agreement
new: type in CATEGORIES ('safety & boundaries' fails); evaluation_target, importance in sets
impact: Script FAIL; see JD-S9.

old: The file declares its own answer in annotations.kind, and that declaration is a claim to check
new: Classify each criterion yourself from its description; its annotations type is a claim to check ... an unstated standard labelled `constraint` escapes the conduct test, and a stated rule labelled `conduct` escapes JD-16 (HEAD keeps the labels `constraint`/`conduct`, which are no longer type values; 8c37863a's correction to `instruction following` was reverted by the merge)
impact: Manual, FAIL thresholds unchanged. Reviewers compare their outcome/constraint/conduct reading against type; for constraints the label is type = "instruction following". Treat the stale `constraint`/`conduct` label words as meaning that.

old: a constraint criterion carries kind = "constraint" and category = "instruction following"; a tool-use constraint labelled category = "tool use" breaks that agreement
new: a constraint criterion carries annotations type = "instruction following"; a genuine tool-use constraint labelled type = "tool use" is mislabelled
impact: No quoted contract_sentence/contract_file in the file any more; the reviewer still must find and quote the sentence (JD-16.1). Builders should keep the sentence in LEVERS/TRUTH so a reviewer can find it.

old: bde868c4: list every criterion whose annotations carry type = "instruction following"
new: HEAD (same as 9b8229f6): list every criterion whose annotations carry kind = "constraint" (which always comes with category = "instruction following")
impact: Net unchanged vs 9b8229f6, but now refers to retired keys that J6 fails, so a literal reading finds no constraint criteria. Reviewers must read it as type = "instruction following". Upstream defect: report to PL.

old: bde868c4: chown root + chmod 755 /logs/verifier is ok; 700 warns
new: HEAD (same as 9b8229f6): chown root + chmod 700 /logs/verifier is ok; anything else warns
impact: Net unchanged vs 9b8229f6; reverts bde868c4. All 4 current bundles use 755 and now WARN H5. Severity WARN. Decide with PL which mode to ship (Harbor host-read issue on Linux was the reason for 755).

old: bde868c4: chown root:root plus chmod 755 ... A bundle that still uses 700 earns an H5 warn
new: HEAD (same as 9b8229f6): chown root:root plus chmod 700
impact: Net unchanged vs 9b8229f6; reverts bde868c4. Same action as H5.

old: environment/data/ exists and holds the input the agent works on, at least one file.
new: environment/ holds the Dockerfile and one or more input directories (any names) and nothing else; every input directory holds at least one file and is copied into the image by a COPY/ADD in environment/Dockerfile.
impact: Script-owned (structure_qc S4), FAIL.

old: environment/data/ holds ALL input; data lives at /app/data because of COPY data /app/data
new: <input-dir>/ ... one or more directories, any names, each COPYed; each lands where its COPY puts it; no input dir exists in the grading container
impact: Context text; same action as DS-1/TS-1.

old: environment/ allowed entries {Dockerfile, data}
new: environment/ allows Dockerfile plus any non-hidden directory; a loose file fails
impact: Script FAIL. Loose files directly under environment/ still fail.

old: environment/data/ exists and holds at least one file
new: at least one input directory; every one non-empty and a COPY/ADD source in environment/Dockerfile; COPY . is NOT recognised at HEAD (8c37863a whole-context fix reverted), so a bundle using COPY . /app fails S4
impact: Script FAIL. Use one explicit COPY per input directory.

old: no input declaration; every archetype implied environment/data -> /app/data
new: [[inputs]] dir/mount entries (default data -> /app/data) plus optional datagen_input (default first input); generator dies on bad names, duplicate dirs/mounts, mount '/' or '/app'
impact: Custom archetypes or bundles must declare their input dirs; datagen.py writes into datagen_input.

old: environment/data/{repo/ -> repo.zip (source_archives), api_contract.md, context files}; COPY data /app/data; instruction: extract /app/data/repo.zip
new: environment/repo/ (COPY --chown=1000:1000 repo /app/repo) + environment/ci/ (api_contract.md + 5 datagen context files, COPY ci /app/ci); source_archives removed; datagen_input = ci; instruction, contract, TRUTH and solve.py use /app/repo and /app/ci; solve.py copytree instead of zip extract
impact: Any repo-patch bundle must ship repo/ + ci/ with exactly those COPY lines, or validator FAILs §1.4 and §5.5 (schema-migration-plan-repair does today).

old: environment/data/{service/ -> service.zip (source_archives), contract, plan files}; COPY data /app/data; instruction: extract service.zip to /app/service
new: environment/service/ (COPY service /app/service) + environment/data/ (COPY data /app/data); source_archives removed; datagen_input = data; instruction says /app/service already holds simulator and client (no extraction)
impact: Same class of change as repo-patch: service-interaction bundles need service/ + data/ and two COPY lines.

old: 8-key annotations with effect type, evidence, residue, kind, category (+contract_sentence/contract_file or serves)
new: 4-key annotations: mode, type (category), evaluation_target, importance
impact: Copy the 4-key shape; generator refuses any other key list (_judge_criteria).

old: provenance carried authored_by: harbor-generator, status: generated_reference, archetype, generator_seed, trailer_token; prose said 'drawn from generator seed {{SEED_HEX}}' and 'archetype'
new: those 5 keys dropped; prose says 'specific to this task instance'; verified_by text shortened
impact: TRUTH.md must not narrate production; matches DS-27.

old: provenance has non-empty uuid, instance_id, task_name, fix_patch_sha256, solve_py_sha256, language, authored_by, status
new: provenance has non-empty uuid, instance_id, task_name, fix_patch_sha256, solve_py_sha256, language; FAIL if authored_by, status, archetype, generator_seed or trailer_token present; FAIL if TRUTH.md text matches generate_bundle|harbor-generator|archetype(s)|scaffold|generator seed|datagen|'this bundle/task was built/generated/...' (QC DS-27)
impact: Resolves the old VB 15.5 vs DS-27 conflict (Q13). Never write the word 'archetype', 'scaffold' or 'datagen' anywhere in TRUTH.md. Severity FAIL.

old: environment/ contains exactly Dockerfile and data/
new: environment/ contains exactly Dockerfile and the detected archetype's declared [[inputs]] dirs (title still says 'data/ only')
impact: Validator enforces the archetype's layout, not QC's open layout: a custom-artifact bundle falls back to format-recovery (data only). Severity FAIL.

old: the only COPY is 'COPY data /app/data' and it is the last non-comment line
new: COPY lines (flags like --chown stripped) are exactly 'COPY <dir> <mount>' for each declared input, and the last line is one of them (title still says 'data only')
impact: Severity FAIL. Order of the input COPY lines is free; nothing may follow them.

old: environment/data is flat (no subdirectories) and has at least one file
new: every environment/ input directory is non-empty; subdirectories allowed
impact: The 'keep data flat' rule is gone from the validator. Severity FAIL.

old: archetype read from TRUTH.md provenance 'archetype:' line, fallback format-recovery
new: archetype = the unique template whose archetype.toml artifacts equal task.toml artifacts (sorted), fallback format-recovery; --archetype overrides (its help text is stale)
impact: Detection now depends on the artifact list. A bundle with custom artifacts is checked as format-recovery and FAILs §1.12 (emberforge does). A bundle that keeps an archetype's artifacts gets that archetype's layout rules.

old: environment/data flat file count >= min_inputs
new: file count over all input directories, recursive, >= min_inputs
impact: Files inside repo/ trees now count toward min_inputs.

old: no file under environment/data > 100 MB
new: no input file in any input directory > 100 MB
impact: Severity FAIL; same limit.

old: solution audit and visible-corpus text read environment/data only
new: read every input directory
impact: None for builders.

old: built images from the bundle itself and read /logs/verifier/reward.txt
new: builds from an exe_copy.py tests-only copy (judge removed) and reads reward.json['reward']; needs no API key
impact: --semantic is usable without OPENAI_API_KEY (not run here; UNVERIFIED that it now works end to end).

old: ablation reran the oracle once per file in /app/data
new: --ablation sample (default: one unit per input dir + up to 8 hash-picked), full (every unit), off; --jobs N (default 2) parallel containers; a tree dir (repo/) is one unit; a full pass recorded in memory for identical data is reused; report field 'ablation' and check D4-ablation
impact: Default runs are now sampled; run --ablation full once before sign-off and quote the mode.

old: A3 FAIL when a judge contract_sentence is not verbatim in instruction.md
new: check removed (no contract_sentence key exists)
impact: Nothing checks constraint sentences mechanically any more; reviewers do it under JD-16/IN-15.

old: read 'archetype:' from TRUTH.md to find ablation_max
new: validate_bundle.detect_archetype (artifacts match); unknown -> ablation_max 0.5
impact: Custom-artifact bundles get the 0.5 default ablation ceiling unless --ablation-max is passed.

old: no layout check; any judge annotation keys accepted
new: _check_input_layout dies unless environment/ = Dockerfile + declared inputs, each non-empty and COPYed to its mount; _judge_criteria dies on non-4-key annotations
impact: Generator refuses old-shape templates/bundles.

old: {{SHIPPED_DATA}} embedded environment/data
new: {{SHIPPED_DATA}} embeds the datagen_input dir; {{SHIPPED:<dir>}} embeds any other declared input
impact: Common rule 6 must re-embed every embedded input dir, not only data/.

old: harbor:<archetype>:<FORMAT_TAG>:<seed hex>
new: <format_tag lower>:<sha256(archetype:tag:seed)[:16]>
impact: Same seed now yields a different trailer than before; regenerated bundles are not byte-identical to older ones.

old: files listed as /app/data/<name>; memory keyed by bare file name
new: files listed at their image path for every input dir; memory keyed '<dir>/<path>'
impact: TRUTH data lists and gen_memory rows change shape.

old: bde868c4: chmod 755 /logs/verifier
new: HEAD (same as 9b8229f6): chmod 700 /logs/verifier
impact: Net unchanged vs 9b8229f6; the merge reverted 8c37863a/bde868c4. Generated bundles get 700; current bundles have 755 (H5 WARN).

old: >=2,000 lines per record file and >=20,000 total, over /app/data
new: same numbers, over every file of every input directory (tree units expanded)
impact: No new numbers; repo/ source files now count toward the 20k total.
